title: HelperSSHCommandNamesParams
description: One half of the PATH enumeration: the cheap per-session invalidation probe, or the full scan of executable names. The phase is a member of a closed set and not a command, and the nonce is the invocation's frame marker — the scripts print it around their answers and the parser accepts nothing else.

nonce.description: The invocation's frame marker, minted by the caller. It rides the heredoc delimiter as well, so the delimiter cannot collide with the script's own text.
